job.title: Paid Internship Programme
job.description:
We are hiring corps members and graduates for a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju-Lekki) and Abuja. No experience needed. Selected candidates will be trained for 6 to 12 months.

Responsibilities

  • Join a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and Abuja.
  • Be trained for 6 to 12 months, learning how the business works from the people who run it.
  • Support the team with day-to-day tasks as you learn.
  • No experience is needed: selected candidates are trained from the start.

Requirements

  • A serving corps member or a graduate of a Nigerian university
  • No previous experience needed
  • Good communication skills and a willingness to learn
  • Able to work full time in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and/or Abuja
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Paid internship.
  • 6 to 12 months of training.

  • Work with suppliers, the sales team and customer service to keep the store running smoothly.

  • Able to work a hybrid schedule in Wuye, Abuja
